fm.title: Beaglebone blue
fm.description: Hardware peripheral access for BeagleBone Blue board (5 blocks)

rows.intent: Access motor and servo actuator peripherals on BeagleBone Blue — use for driving DC motors, servos, or ESCs from generated code
Access basic I/O peripherals on BeagleBone Blue — use for GPIO, LED, and button interfaces on the BeagleBone Blue board
Access communication peripherals on BeagleBone Blue — use for I2C, SPI, UART, or CAN interfaces on the BeagleBone Blue
Access onboard sensors on BeagleBone Blue — use for reading IMU, barometer, or encoder data from the BeagleBone Blue
Access video capture on BeagleBone Blue — use for camera input and image processing on the BeagleBone Blue platform
